name: Spicy Pork Tacos with Kiwi, Cucumber & Avocado Salsa

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 kiwifruit
1 ½ avocados
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ limes
1 ½ jalapeño peppers

instructions.primary_message: Trim, peel, and small dice kiwis; place in a medium bowl.
Halve, pit, and scoop out the avocado flesh with a spoon; small dice and add to the bowl with the kiwi.
Trim and small dice cucumbers; add to the bowl.
Juice limes into the bowl, then season with salt and crushed red pepper. Stir to combine the salsa and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Finely dice. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add jalapeño, pork, and spices; cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1.02 kg lean ground pork
2 tbsp chili powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
To serve, divide tortillas between plates and fill with spicy pork. Top with salsa and enjoy!
